units.name: Improvised Barricades
units.notes: 10" of improvised barricades made of earth filled boxes, rubble, furniture, destroyed vehicles etc. Counts as hard cover for infantry behind it.

units.name: Machine Gun Dugout

unitComposition.name: 3 men and a tripod MG34 in reinforced cover

units.notes: The cover is lost if the MG team move.

units.name: Mortar Pit
units.notes: The cover is lost if the mortar team move.

units.name: Fortified Building
units.notes: A single chosen building, anywhere on the table. It counts as reinforced cover rather than hard cover.

units.name: Foxholes
units.notes: Deploy up to 10 infantry in foxholes; they count as reinforced cover until they move.

units.name: Sniper Hideout
units.notes: A single sniper in reinforced cover. It can be placed anywhere outside of the opponent's deployment zone. The cover is lost if the sniper moves.

units.name: AT Gun Dugout
units.notes: Reinforced cover for a single anti-tank gun and crew until the gun moves. The gun must be purchased from the army list.

units.name: Booby-Trapped Building
units.notes: A chosen building anywhere on the table has been wired with booby-traps. The first time an enemy unit enters the building roll a D6. On a 2+ it detonates and the unit takes a 3/3+ HE hit. On a 1 there is a fault and the booby trap fails to go off!

units.name: Improvised Road Block
units.notes: Something large and heavy across a road. Place on any road or track, anywhere on table. It counts as an obstacle.

units.name: Sniper
units.notes: A Sniper with a spotter increases its maximum range from 30" to 40", hitting on a 6.

units.name: Counter Battery Fire Mission
units.notes: The counter battery fire mission is effective on a 5+.

units.name: Timed 80mm Mortar Barrage
units.notes: Fired by a battery of four 80mm mortars. Before the game, write down the turn the guns will fire on. The points cost includes a pre-registered target as the target point of the barrage.

units.name: Timed 105mm Barrage
units.notes: Fired by a battery of four 105mmL28 guns. Before the game, write down the turn the guns will fire on. The points cost includes a pre-registered target as the target point of the barrage.

units.name: Timed 150mm Barrage
units.notes: Fired by a battery of four 150L30 guns. Before the game, write down the turn the guns will fire on. The points cost includes a pre-registered target as the target point of the barrage.
